alt: Labelled diagram of the human digestive system: mouth (palate, uvula, tongue, teeth), salivary glands (sublingual, submandibular, parotid), pharynx, esophagus, stomach, liver, gallbladder, common bile duct, pancreas and pancreatic duct, small intestine (duodenum, jejunum, ileum), appendix, and large intestine (caecum, ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid colon, rectum) with the anus.
